syncSegmentsEn.text: Lord, You are the ship upon the sea
How peaceful it is aboard Your ship
In leaving You I met unending sorrow
Like a sheep lost in the wilderness
Remembering the past, I cannot sleep all night
How could I forget Your grace?
You heal me in sickness and help me in hardship
You are always with me when I am lonely
How could I forget each time You rescued me?
How could I forget the encouragement of Scripture?
How could I forget the promise I made with raised hands?
How could I forget that call within my soul?
Lord, Your love lasts forever
Lord, Your love never changes
Lord, please hold my hand
Let me finish the road set before me
